Friend — Please see below for a revised newsletter. Our Atlanta Press Club debate is being held on TUESDAY from 7:00-8:00 pm. Details on how to watch are below. Have a great weekend!
---
---
# _**Early Voting**_
---
|
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/fd49a138ac952f06c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
Monday marks the official start of early voting in Georgia! We’re counting on each of you to go to the polls and cast your ballot — and bring 22 of your friends with you. **[Our team has put together a Voter Resources page that’s a one-stop shop for everything you need to know about voting.](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/370e7404784536d6c3d6b838967d376c/37793)** Hope you’ll use it as a resource as you plan when you’re going to vote.
---
---
# **_Open Border_**

---
[| | |
---|---|---](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/58b6b94cfeca56dec3d6b838967d376c/37793)
This week, we launched our first television spot of the campaign. It highlights the crisis at our southern border, how Joe Biden and Raphael Warnock’s policies created it, and how stopping it is going to take more than another status quo Republican. This ad is going to continue airing across Georgia, and I hope you’ll personally share it with each of your contacts.
---
---
# _**Closing Argument State Tour**_
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/d9d99e68dc8fdf85c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
From Chattahoochee Hills to Bartow County, Norcross to Ringgold... B.I.G. crowds have joined us at each of our stops this week! We must nominate a Republican who will show up, hear what’s on the voters’ hearts, answer the tough questions, and who won’t be outworked.
---
---
# **_Atlanta Press Club Debate_**
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/8a15dbee4ebdb921c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
**_UPDATE: On TUESDAY_** , I’ll participate in the Atlanta Press Club’s debate. Looking forward to a serious discussion of the issues and sharing why trusted experienced — not celebrity — will defeat Raphael Warnock in November. The debate will be live on GPB from 7:00-8:00 pm and streamed live on [**The Atlanta Press Club’s Facebook Page**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/4e5547649bb67579c3d6b838967d376c/37793) and **[GPB.org](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/c18856bb5893f6cac3d6b838967d376c/37793)**. It will also be available online on GPB and Atlanta Press Club social media afterwards. Hope you’ll tune in!
---
---
# **_One More Thing_**
---
Please follow our campaign's [**Facebook**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/3d4c677561e21d56c3d6b838967d376c/37793), **[Twitter](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/894f396a16822897c3d6b838967d376c/37793)** , and [**Instagram**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/f90687cbc6f8ca81c3d6b838967d376c/37793) pages if you aren't already, and make sure 10 of your friends are too! With early voting starting on Monday, the need to keep our ads running online and on television has never been greater. [**I hope you’ll consider helping us share our closing argument by donating whatever you can, right now.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/9f1dfb86bdf288a1c3d6b838967d376c/37793) Thank you again for your friendship, prayers, and support!
---
[](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/ef160644b95c6f05c3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
Gary Black
---
[**DONATE NOW »**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/ac3f7e56571c093ec3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
| | [](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/ab00fd3be6cbbdbdc3d6b838967d376c/37793)
---
I couldn’t be prouder to have you on our team, and your support is absolutely crucial to our efforts. Here’s why.
Raphael Warnock has already stockpiled $25.6 million to keep this seat, and with it the U.S. Senate, in Democrat hands. Democrats know, as we know, that this seat will decide who controls the majority, and I’m the only Republican who can win. But in order to do so, we have to start now. And these emails are a vital part of our efforts.
With one conservative vote, we can restore Republican leadership to the U.S. Senate and help take America back. I’m ready — and if you are too, I hope you’ll donate here or below.
---
[**DONATE NOW »**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/0e82897e342bb71a041ad8cde91a9694/37793/21e840d029e1f348/66e5084c10886044c3d6b838967d376c/37793)

>
Here's the way I see it: If we keep fighting side by side, we can hold our heads up high this election season.
And if we can get Congress to seize this moment, we can make real change. Here’s some of what I’m lighting the fire of urgency for right now:
* Starting to root corruption out of Washington by banning members of Congress and their spouses from owning or trading individual stocks.
* Cracking down on corporate price gouging, breaking up monopolies, and lowering costs for families.
* Tackling climate change to protect our planet for future generations.
* Getting freeloading corporations and freeloading billionaires to pay a fair share by passing a Corporate Profits Minimum Tax and a Billionaires Income Tax.
* Bringing down the cost of prescription drugs, including capping the cost of insulin at $35 a month. There’s a whole lot the president can get done with executive actions here — but I’m still pushing Congress to act, too.
* Canceling student debt — President Biden can make this happen with one stroke of a pen.
* Ensuring more workers are eligible for overtime pay — another thing the president can do all by himself.

That’s just a start. In Washington, I’ll keep banging every drum I can find to make sure we get stuff done by November. And I won’t be doing it alone. I’ll be fighting alongside a grassroots movement — _this_ grassroots movement.
Together, we’ll also keep working to elect more Democrats up and down the ballot. More Democrats who understand that this moment calls for bold changes. More Democrats who are ready to put power in the hands of working people. More Democrats who know how to fight and know how to win.
That way, after November, we’ll know that we’ve improved the lives of tens of millions of Americans — and we’ll know that we’re on track to accomplish even more. Side by side, we can make Washington work for everyone, not just the rich and the powerful.
[_**But first, we’ve got to hit all of our fundraising targets for 2022. And that includes our April goal. Elizabeth

subject: How should we elect the president?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vsEZe00HNv

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only
take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our
nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives-but
supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we
elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the
Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osEZe00HNv

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent
matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but
the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by
progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to
change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do
away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a
National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to
me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more
clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning
this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and
opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on
Presidential Selection by using the link below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

For most of our nation's history, the
Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution,
was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to
preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have
joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional
bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution
has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to
provide young people with a proper grounding in American
civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance
of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has
expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide,
directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the
Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide
through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The
Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over 5.6 million households and
businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of
liberty;

Promoting constitutional education
through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of
America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across
America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education
through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which
launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools
nationwide.

Your answers to the National Survey on
Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most
effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the
importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the
importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this
critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent
topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection
and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a
few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure
link I've provided below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey

And after you take your survey, I hope you
will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a
tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing
truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its
extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept
ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form
of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is
essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the
National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for
your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of
liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since
1844

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below: For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government. But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty. This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty. Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states. These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include: Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;" Reaching over 5.6 million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty; Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people; Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America, as well as to members of our armed forces; and Restoring excellence to K-12 education through Hillsdale's Barney Charter School Initiative, which launches and provides guidance to classical K-12 charter schools nationwide. Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the importance of the Electoral College. And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future. So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below: And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift. Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts, while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work. Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Dear Peter,
I just wanted to reach out with an update regarding our critical end-of-month fundraising deadline. While many of our supporters have stepped up to help meet our goal of $9,999, we’re still a little behind – so we’re looking for a huge number of grassroots donations to make up the difference!
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aprileom_0430?amount=20.22]
With the primary election right around the corner, I am proud to tell you that we are closer to the finish line than any other team in the race. I’ve already received the endorsements of well over 120 current and former elected officials and labor unions – the most of any candidate for Governor. And recent polls consistently show that we have a strong lead over the rest of the Democratic field.
We couldn’t have gotten this far without the support of people like you. Day in and day out, our Team Franchot activists, allies, volunteers and friends are stepping up to help grow our movement from the grassroots. Our momentum is truly palpable. From the bottom of my heart, thank you for making all of this possible.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aprileom_0430?amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aprileom_0430?amount=20.22]
The end of this race is in sight. On July 19, Marylanders will make a decision about the future of our state for decades to come. By helping us meet our fundraising goal for April by 11:59 PM tonight, you’ll help us invest in the critical tools we need to secure our victory. So, what do you say?
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aprileom_0430?amount=10]
CHIP IN $20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aprileom_0430?amount=20.22]

As the Local Candidate for Governor, I’ve visited so many of our communities in all corners of the state. Whether I’m visiting Mountain Maryland or the Eastern Shore, I often hear a similar refrain: we know you, we trust you, we’re with you. The people of Maryland know me, and I know them. You deserve responsive, respectful, and results-oriented service from your government. If I’m blessed to lead, that’s precisely what I’ll deliver.
As Governor, I’ll tackle the student debt crisis head on, make critical investments in 21st century infrastructure projects to create 100,000 new jobs, support our labor unions, lower the costs of healthcare and housing, and so much more. If you want to make my vision for our future a reality, then please rush $10 or whatever you can spare right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aprileom_0430?amount=20.22]
Our challenges are sweeping. So too must be our solutions. Enough talk – let’s get it done.
Thank you,

When you’re stuck in a hole, the first thing you need to do is stop digging. body:
GOP congressional frontrunner Jerome Munson and other extreme right operatives rallied at the State Capitol in support of the Jan. 6 insurrectionists | | |

| _While supporters of Trump were storming the US Capitol, others were rallying at the Minnesota State Capitol in St. Paul. Photo by[Chad David, Flickr](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=e8b045105b&e=8914b14955)._
---
| |
---
| Friend,

Representative Marjorie Taylor Greene, of Georgia, was yet one more Republican member of Congress to participate in the seditious insurrection of January 6, 2021. Now we know she apparently went so far as to [suggest](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=180ad4b896&e=8914b14955) that President Trump should impose martial law to re-do the election. [I spoke out against this criminal sedition](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=c278401b3a&e=8914b14955), including a meeting in the West Wing of the White House where President Trump and his advisors seriously considered declaration of martial law in order to “re-do” the election.

_**That would have ended our democracy right then and there. **_

Come January 6, far too many GOP Members of Congress backed President Trump's call to refuse to certify the election. Some Members of Congress openly encouraged the violent crowd outside the Capitol before they stormed the building, murdered a police officer and threatened to hang Vice President Pence if he did not certify the election for Trump.

**Meanwhile, Minnesota State Senator Jerome Munson and other extreme right GOP operatives[held a rally](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=808405cdfc&e=8914b14955) at the Minnesota Capitol in support of the insurrectionists of January 6. **

**Munson is the frontrunner in a contentious GOP primary for the open U.S. House seat in Minnesota's First Congressional District.**

Our democracy is in grave danger if we send insurrectionists like Munson to Congress. I am running to stop him, but I need your support in the DFL primary, the special election in August, and the general election in November.

[**Can you pitch in $5, $25, $100 or whatever you are able to my campaign so I can stand up against radical Republicans in Congress?**](https://gmail.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b5e28d948d577e19f5422e846&id=40377f4012&e=8914b14955)

I promise when I am elected to Congress, I will stand up against these insurgents. Thank you,

Richard Painter

Hello Friend,Do you have a favorite biblical story that you heard as a child and have not forgotten as an adult? Does the message from that story still resonate?I sure do. It's the story of the man who found treasure buried in a field he probably walked by every single day. Instead of trying to steal the treasure or just leaving it behind, the man sold everything he owned so that he could afford to buy the field and its secrets.The idea of buried treasure captivated my young mind and to this day, I think about all the man was willing to sacrifice in order to obtain the immeasurable worth of that treasure.You may not remember the specific title, and you may forget the Scripture references, but you will never forget that story**** and its inspirational message. Jesus knew this, and he was a masterful storyteller! His stories were called parables, from a Greek word meaning "to lay alongside of."And this is exactly what Jesus did-each parable He shared communicated bold, world-changing truth hidden in an example of everyday life. body:
Please Support me Today
| | | |
---
---
---
| | |
---|---
|
As I worked through Covid as a registered nurse at a Massachusetts Hospital, I saw first hand what government mandates and regulations did to individuals, and to the medical industry.

Even though I worked throughout Covid caring for sick patients, while I was pregnant and nursing my son, I was still told that unless I agreed to get the Covid vaccine, that I would have to leave my job.

These types of mandates are simply wrong; and when I heard Geoff Diehl say that on Day One, he would restore all of those from the public sector who had lost their jobs; and on day two, he would fire anyone who thought these mandates were a good idea; I knew I had to join him in his fight to bring back Massachusetts.

That is why I decided to step up and run for Lt. Governor. This is my story. [Leah Cole Allen's Story](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001FELUW-taEFdqxW_egmi9JOXHvKvfzRYYpSDooYNrTPWh4jds_Px1QcEvH1zEQQGqRBCEnybsVB1rUXjadE4eE59MtvFN9qLjQiJc68j5u4usexLU8PES0DQcbayW80d8vesmjlhugfmo1ewTuaSaS37lhn7Qi8HzT2SxfQB-0QXkwcCjOttcpw==&c=wFrK-lSsBolw3dwBq-_FMU4UUnQld4NXNn7xnRrk_pkwHZYJ60VDCA==&ch=TNCCljhBjqHZhPn11HFFEFOtjxsDFBAa5N9ulD93hgerHXfI66wMXQ==)

We the people need to take back our state! Please help me to represent you, your rights, and to help Geoff Diehl fix what has been broken in our Commonwealth.

_**" I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Peter,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_" Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Peter, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said:

_" I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers." _
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

**You can help me prove them wrong by standing with me at this critical moment.**

We'd like to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. **[Can I count on you to help me today?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60271566:JXmskHoQN:m:1:3253819041:2CA4E2E4C6ED9BAA54FF01BE4AD6F1CB:r)**

_Just imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat. They'd be fired immediately after going off air._

**I won't be quiet about this.** This columnist is saying horrible things about fellow human beings based on the color of their skin. That's simply wrong.

**[We hope you'll take a moment today to support our Senate campaign and show the people who want us to fail just how much support there is for Black conservatives in this country.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/60271566:JXmskHoQN:m:1:3253819041:2CA4E2E4C6ED9BAA54FF01BE4AD6F1CB:r)**

subject: Conservative revival? Update from the Mississippi Center for Public Policy
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/conservativerevival?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
|
Dear Friend,

I recently flew over to England for a few days. Sitting on the ‘plane, I got thinking about the current state of conservatism in America.

When I first arrived in the US, the liberty movement seemed to be in a mess.

Donald Trump had just lost the White House to a radical progressive. Certain US states had lurched to the far left, and a number of once solidly conservative states were looking wobbly.

Fast-forward to today, and a revival of the conservative movement is underway across the country.

Parent power has become a force to be reckoned with as moms and dads in states like Virginia rise up against leftist control of their childrens’ classrooms.

Support for conservative values are now polling remarkably well with middle-class Asian and Hispanic Americans.

The federal government might have hosed $2 trillion extra at the economy last year. That failed to produce growth (the economy shrank in the first three months of this year). It did produce higher prices, making millions of Americans poorer.

Confronted by economic problems, the liberty movement needs to set out a recovery roadmap for America to follow based on lower taxes and less government. Here in Mississippi, conservatives have led the way delivering the largest tax cut in our state's history.

For decades, the left has relentlessly attacked and undermined so many of the things about America that we hold dear. Heroic figures from the past have been traduced for not holding identical opinions to those alive today. Statues have been toppled and young Americans have been taught that their country is always wrong.

Yet even against the wave of "woke" we are seeing conservatives getting organized and defending the things that make American so extraordinary.

Conservative historians and thinkers are starting to speak out. The absurdity of ‘woke’ ideology is being exposed. A bill we passed to combat Critical Race theory in our state has become a model that other states are using.

Big tech platforms have censored conservatives. A small clique of twentysomething hipsters in California have tried to control the conversation across America.

Once again things seem to be about to change. Elon Musk wants to buy Twitter, promising to ensure free speech. The progressives seem poised to lose their unfair online advantage.

In short, the America conservative movement is really starting to get its act together. Battles that looked hopeless can be won. Long years of defeat and retreat are over. A conservative revival is on the cards – and as I return to the US, I am so thrilled that the Mississippi Center for Public Policy is playing its part!

---
| |
---
Have a wonderful, restful weekend!

Warm Regards,

Douglas Carswell
President & CEO

|

name: Stacey Abrams
subject: All eyes are on Texas and Georgia
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
Will you split a donation between Beto and me?
#
This is a critical moment for our democracy, and my friend Beto and I need your help.
In Georgia _and_ in Texas, we’ve seen what it means to have cruel and divisive governors who are more interested in building their own power than fighting for their people. The stakes couldn’t be higher in either of our races.
**That’s why I am running — to fight for Georgians and defeat the Republicans. And that’s why Beto is running to fight for Texans and defeat Greg Abbott. We will do everything in our power to make your lives better.**
Both Beto and I have incredible campaigns powered by grassroots donors like you and we need your help. **Together, we can make history in the South.**
[Will you split a contribution right now — even just $3 — between my campaign to be governor of Georgia and Beto's campaign to be governor of Texas? Here in Georgia TODAY is our very last grassroots fundraising reporting deadline before the primary election, and Beto is facing an important end-of-month deadline in Texas, too. We’re counting on your support.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55905?refcode=ema20220430-187179&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=187179%2E444211%2EfGCZMH)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55905?refcode=ema20220430-187179&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=187179%2E444211%2EfGCZMH)**
One of the most urgent issues at stake in both of our races is protecting democracy from dangerous and sustained attacks on voting rights.
But that’s why Beto and I are here. We have proven that we can do the work for our people, protect voting rights — and that we have what it takes to change the course of history.
When Greg Abbott turned his attention to voter suppression last summer, I was glad to see Beto taking immediate action, mobilizing even more people into our democracy. He testified at the Texas Capitol against several anti-democratic bills and traveled across Texas to bring as many people as possible to the conversation.
And here in Georgia, I have stood up against Brian Kemp and his Republican allies as they shamelessly work to erode voting rights and use their positions to try and give themselves the advantage in this race.
**Alongside grassroots supporters like you, Beto and I have been fighting hard for voting rights and to open the gates of opportunity for the people of Georgia and Texas. But in order to win in November and really get to work, we need your support again today.**
[If you’re ready to dig deep and make history, I’m asking you to split a donation between our campaigns before midnight to ensure we’re able to win in Georgia and in Texas. ](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55905?refcode=ema20220430-187179&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=187179%2E444211%2EfGCZMH)
We're in this together, and every single donation makes a huge difference.
Thank you for joining this fight,
Stacey Abrams

> _We thought you might want to see this special message from our friends at the new Republican Accountability PAC._
Friend,

As we get closer to the 2022 election, it’s more important than ever to raise the alarm about the candidates, office-holders, and media figures who pose a threat to our democracy. That’s why we’re launching the Threat to Democracy of the Week to share our work and research tracking the worst actors in our politics today. You may have heard of some of them, and others you likely haven’t. **To kick things off, we’re spotlighting Ohio congressional candidate and former Trump official Max Miller.**
---
---
Miller is running to replace outgoing congressman Anthony Gonzalez. People like Marco Rubio take money from industries that will pay to stop progress at all costs. clean_body: Peter, We are in the last 24 hours of our April fundraising period, and I felt compelled to reach out | | | Peter, We are in the last 24 hours of our April fundraising period, and I felt compelled to reach out and tell each and every one of you just how much your support means to me. I am running for the US Senate because I know that the institution is no longer working, and we need new, less corrupt leadership. Right now, a huge portion of the President's agenda is stuck in the Senate because our majority is not large enough for us to pass things that the majority of the American people agree on. People like Marco Rubio take money from industries that will pay to stop progress at all costs. That is such a significant detriment to democracy that so many people have lost faith in our entire system. I hear that, and I am with you in the fight for a real, functioning democracy. And that starts right here in the form of small-dollar donations for grassroots candidates like me. We are running out of time to do something, but I know that now is our moment. – Ken Russell Ken Russell is a Democrat running for U.S. Senate in Florida. # Primary moved to August 23, 2022
---
| | |

|
### THANK YOU FOR YOUR SUPPORT!!!!

On behalf of my family and our campaign, I want to thank the countless volunteers that braved snow, wind and freezing rain walking door to door meeting with thousands of Republican voters in District 1.

### As you may have heard, the state's highest court has ruled that the Democrat drawn Congressional lines were unconstitutional. The court has moved our primary to August 23, 2022. We believe the new district lines will be drawn by May 20th, per a court order. As the only Republican candidate born and LIVING in this district we are not backing down.
These past few months truly showed me how committed the people are to making their country great again and putting America First.

But we have powerful forces who are more interested in advancing their own selfish interests than representing you. Sadly, we are seeing it in our own party. That's why I need your help to defeat these RINOs in the voting booth.

[We are at the end of the month and need to meet our fundraising goals. Please consider chipping in $20, $50, or even $100 to our movement. It will help us with signs and literature as we continue to walk this district and get our message out. ](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001TKR7ZnET2JlA-M33pJQZHFnnO5g8ltfsCXchZvCOXIlZ_BSZBrr4XVW7GQpuY5yMgnfgFvfDTQMEcp2JR-3x2ifJkU9rZZhjyUJcl5yZ8OfQwqROt21dcHK3RmC2Ws3Iwe7InyeEGo9Yp8lpTh0ubbW5wPvL9DTabW1c9deZQinTJJ0X7FWA5qA7ruFBreoCQQPIwNwQiG0=&c=NzCifVA-_8UoWZogN_qVl1ADONOfOFAnnLa0Bro7ZdngBg9PVRzVOg==&ch=GEnN5vCGjv-3ov3JJtsK8W4ngFs2QQJFmjUao77CDFTO_NPLvVywVA==)

We need all hands on deck to take on Zinke’s money machine. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44763192/343007847/1820125544?refcode=em-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTMyZDYwZi1hZmM4LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vl7s3HgvYUkB5C5fpqe4h9jg0CeUyZb32CUoMdt59fQ=) Hey friend, it’s Nell -- Cora’s finance director for the campaign. Before I ask you to send in **[a $3 donation](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44763193/343007848/-10092236?refcode=em-4.30.22-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODQ0NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MTMyZDYwZi1hZmM4LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Vl7s3HgvYUkB5C5fpqe4h9jg0CeUyZb32CUoMdt59fQ=)** to help us meet our end-of-month deadline, I wanted to give you a little peek at the money machine we’re up against in this race for Congress. We reviewed Ryan Zinke’s FEC filing report. Here’s a quick breakdown of some of Zinke’s financials from last quarter:

subject: Democrats' worst nightmare.

body:
-
I’m putting this at the TOP of your inbox.
| | Dear Peter, I’m putting this at the TOP of your inbox to make sure you didn’t miss my email to you. Ever since John James announced his candidacy for the House of Representatives, the Democrats have been hell-bent on defeating him. He needs your support more than ever if he’s going to reclaim enough Black voters in Michigan to help put him in Congress. Read my email below to see how you can help.
---
| [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=1)
---
_For America,_ |
---
**Alvin Williams**
President & CEO
BAMPAC, BAMPAC Action Fund
[DONATE](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=2)
---
\- - - - - - Begin Forward - - - - - - **From:** Alvin Williams
**Sent:** Friday, April 22nd 2022 02:00 PM
**To:** Peter
**Subject:Democrats' worst nightmare**
---
| |
---
| | [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=3)
---
| Peter, There's nothing Democrats fear more than outspoken Black conservatives exposing their Liberal LIES about "racist" conservatives to Black voters... ...but a popular Black, Christian conservative, _Army combat veteran, and successful businessman_ like John James **running for Congress** is the **Democrats' worst nightmare**. **[I'm hoping you'll endorse John James for the U.S. House of Representatives, but first let me explain why the Democrats are so terrified of him.](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=4)** The Democrats are gearing up for war, and they fully expect to maintain control of the House this election. **But behind the scenes,_they're terrified_ that John James is about to thwart their entire takeover plot.** And they have good reason to be afraid. | [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=5)
---
##### Captain John James will be the next U.S. Congressman from Michigan, but only with your help.
After all, they saw first-hand in previous elections what John is capable of - _watching in horror as he soared from a 21-point deficit to just 7 points within a few short months._
Shocked that their supposedly _"unbeatable"_ Senator was on the verge of losing to a _"nobody"_ political outsider...
...the panicked Democrats were forced to dump **over $15 million** into slowing down John's relentless surge just enough for well-known, deep-pocketed, and entrenched Democrat Senator Debbie Stabenow to narrowly squeak past.
# John James won more votes (1.9 million) than ANY Republican in Michigan in over a decade.
The Democrats are terrified because they know that if John can nearly topple one of the most powerful Democrats in the U.S. Senate...
**...then they don't stand a chance against John James this election!**
John is a successful, articulate, and intelligent Black conservative whose impeccable character is impossible for liberals to deface with slander and lies.
He's a West Point graduate, Ranger-qualified aviation officer, and retired Army Captain who served with distinction while leading two Apache helicopter platoons in Iraq.
He's also a successful businessman, having quadrupled his company's revenue and added 100 new employees in his first 5 years as President.
And through each step of his journey, John has led with courage, conviction, and a servant-first mentality that comes from his Christian faith.
[](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=6)
---
##### "I am a conservative who happens to be black. I'm in the Republican Party because the platform most aligns with my values. I am pro-life. I am pro-Second Amendment. I am pro-family. I am pro-business."
John calls himself an _"unapologetic Christian, pro-life, pro-business, pro-Second Amendment, conservative outsider"_ but Fox News and others are calling him _**"The future of the GOP."**_
**[And if this isn't enough to make you want to help send John James to the U.S. House of Representatives...](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=7)**
**...let me tell you what scares the Democrats most about John James.**
**John is on a mission to reclaim Black voters by exposing the Liberal LIE that conservatives like you and me are racists.**
He's opening their eyes to the _"Democratic brand of dependency that's being peddled"_ by unmasking Democrats as opportunistic, self-serving politicians who prey on Blacks with lies, empty promises, and failed policies.
And John's damning critiques of the Democrat Party and honest outreach to the Black Community are reclaiming Black voters to the Republican Party.
**John James is a serious threat to the Democrat Party, and they know it!**
_"He's SPECTACULAR. Rarely have I seen a candidate with such great potential. West Point graduate, successful businessman, and an African American leader...**He will be a star.** "_
-President Donald Trump
---
**To say the Democrats are panicking would be an understatement.**
They know John can reclaim enough Black voters to convert Michigan from a long-standing Democrat stronghold into the newest "red state."
And they know that winning a U.S. Congressional race will catapult John to national stardom, guaranteeing that millions of Black voters across America will hear his powerful message and begin fleeing the Democrat Party.
Once elected, Congressman John James will work tirelessly to:
* **EXPOSE** the Liberal Lies to the entire nation
* **RECLAIM** Black voters to the Republican Party
* **END** the Democrats' death-grip on the Black Community

**And Democrats know that if they lose just 12% of the Black vote, it'll be impossible for them to ever win another election.**
# That's why Democrats are terrified of John James and WILL STOP AT NOTHING TO SHUT HIM UP
**[That’s why I pray you'll also make an urgent, recurring donation of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more to help John FIGHT BACK against the Democrats' vicious attacks!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=8)**
BAMPAC Action Fund played an ACTIVE roll helping John James shrink the margin between him and his opponent in the previous election.
With your help, we were able to place billboards in key areas throughout Michigan, like the one you see here:
[](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=9)
---
We also ran radio ads in 3 of the largest black communities in Michigan and reached voters through online video ads in 10 key Michigan counties.
These online video ads were targeted towards Black Americans who’d voted in 2 of the last 4 elections up to that point.
And with your help... _we’ll do it again!_
John James really is _**"the future Republicans have been waiting for,"**_ but that future may never arrive without your committed support.
The Democrats are desperate to STOP John from taking this critical Congressional seat and END his campaign to recruit Black voters to the Republican Party.
And make no mistake about it: the future of our shared conservative values depends on our ability to reclaim Black voters from the Democrats.
**[That’s why your _monthly_ gift of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more is so critical now more than ever!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=10)**
Real change takes time and commitment, and I know that you’re in this fight for the long-haul.
I know you won’t allow our conservative values to fall to the wayside by failing to build a conservative future.
That’s why I’m counting on your help TODAY.
**[So please help defend John James from Democrat attacks and DESTROY the liberal lies with your _monthly_ gift of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more TODAY!](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=11)**
Thank you, and God Bless.
| [](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=12)
---
_For America,_ |
---
**Alvin Williams**
President & CEO
BAMPAC, BAMPAC Action Fund
[DONATE](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=13)
---
**P.S.** John James is the **Democrats' worst nightmare** because he's reclaiming Black voters to the Republican Party by exposing the Liberal LIES about "racist" conservatives that keep Blacks voting for Democrats... **...and he's the ONLY ONE who can win this crucial House race and thwart their plans to retake the U.S. House of Representatives this election.** **That's why they'll stop at nothing to SHUT HIM UP!** **[That’s why I pray you'll make an urgent, monthly contribution of $10, $20.22, $28, $40, $75 or more to support John James up through Election Day.](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=14)** **As a conservative leader in your community, your support is critical to beat back the Democrats' vicious attacks and propel John James to victory.[So please give what you can today.](https://www.bampac.org/johnjamesbaf?info=2022ER0404&recruiter_id=62418&e=523b6806226ba5e2de52820de3975f18&utm_source=bampac&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=2022er0404&n=15)**
---

John calls himself an "unapologetic Christian, pro-life, pro-business, pro-Second Amendment, conservative outsider" but Fox News and others are calling him "The future of the GOP." ...let me tell you what scares the Democrats most about John James. John is on a mission to reclaim Black voters by exposing the Liberal LIE that conservatives like you and me are racists. He's opening their eyes to the "Democratic brand of dependency that's being peddled" by unmasking Democrats as opportunistic, self-serving politicians who prey on Blacks with lies, empty promises, and failed policies. And John's damning critiques of the Democrat Party and honest outreach to the Black Community are reclaiming Black voters to the Republican Party. John James is a serious threat to the Democrat Party, and they know it! "He's SPECTACULAR. Rarely have I seen a candidate with such great potential. West Point graduate, successful businessman, and an African American leader...He will be a star. " -President Donald Trump To say the Democrats are panicking would be an understatement. They know John can reclaim enough Black voters to convert Michigan from a long-standing Democrat stronghold into the newest "red state." And they know that winning a U.S. Congressional race will catapult John to national stardom, guaranteeing that millions of Black voters across America will hear his powerful message and begin fleeing the Democrat Party. Once elected, Congressman John James will work tirelessly to: EXPOSE the Liberal Lies to the entire nation RECLAIM Black voters to the Republican Party END the Democrats' death-grip on the Black Community And Democrats know that if they lose just 12% of the Black vote, it'll be impossible for them to ever win another election. That's why Democrats are terrified of John James and WILL STOP AT NOTHING TO SHUT HIM UP BAMPAC Action Fund played an ACTIVE roll helping John James shrink the margin between him and his opponent in the previous election. With your help, we were able to place billboards in key areas throughout Michigan, like the one you see here: We also ran radio ads in 3 of the largest black communities in Michigan and reached voters through online video ads in 10 key Michigan counties. These online video ads were targeted towards Black Americans who’d voted in 2 of the last 4 elections up to that point. And with your help... we’ll do it again! John James really is "the future Republicans have been waiting for," but that future may never arrive without your committed support. The Democrats are desperate to STOP John from taking this critical Congressional seat and END his campaign to recruit Black voters to the Republican Party. And make no mistake about it: the future of our shared conservative values depends on our ability to reclaim Black voters from the Democrats. Real change takes time and commitment, and I know that you’re in this fight for the long-haul. I know you won’t allow our conservative values to fall to the wayside by failing to build a conservative future. That’s why I’m counting on your help TODAY. Thank you, and God Bless. | For America, | Alvin Williams President & CEO BAMPAC, BAMPAC Action Fund P.S. John James is the Democrats' worst nightmare because he's reclaiming Black voters to the Republican Party by exposing the Liberal LIES about "racist" conservatives that keep Blacks voting for Democrats... ...and he's the ONLY ONE who can win this crucial House race and thwart their plans to retake the U.S. House of Representatives this election. That's why they'll stop at nothing to SHUT HIM UP! _**"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Peter,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Peter, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said:

_"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."_
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

**You can help me prove them wrong by standing with me at this critical moment.**

We'd like to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. **[Can I count on you to help me today?](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=0c0a2eead8904494bff0b2c5bfb5e6dc&_e=vq39PVKAYNwyHJcx-X-Z-au8GNbnF3x2od4rKUCj5SpjSb2yOkOlM6dEEwsTgWGyhtL8Y2fDS5WQI4bJrXwOphRSe_wmWSDHmUn1zkZj8yu-A3h9DsL7q2rmV129i0FhFx4g_QVWu66Lo9dU3gGT6tMej2kpaQwXTQl6S_Jjlh9DACjEep7FmEzesH_TzUOR6T5TKWF9IbczGzJ_FkX_hRg7v45PTp78hGpb-xwsaBz4jcRa8_Epreyb42wUzOOEMjTX5vmiDeq8dqQY50s0oACeCufovmKKsGQoHlf8nMRDWEdXYnE1Zd-FGdn951wG3YZ98b2x-IH8DLHpo3fIeqiE_XMwlx0zASnj5sXTI-fWahKE_5PBabNsgjv8sRUsE6uQpwx16oVSodTzpkswiqfAih_Evr222ikjjMR1udM3TXMWg4q6ocWOOT8_vCF-0_QVF3nwtgdluacM9XnyvTA9jltCs4RqBmPy_Saz4sZLiWiaH4lCa0-_6DEpxHQX)**

– Ana

subject: It’s a family effort
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Booker for Kentucky
body:
[1]Charles Booker

Hi Peter, it’s
Earletta Hearn. My son is Charles Booker.

I recently found a photo of Charles with my mama and daddy, and I know if
they were still here they would be so proud of him.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17972?refcode=em20220430-1851&t=1001&akid=1851%2E346206%2EKe7Tm9 ][IMG]

But I’m not just writing to you today to share cute photos of my son
Charles (even though I have plenty!)

I’m reaching out because the team told me that we’re now at the end of the
month and they’re racing to reach a fundraising deadline tonight. They’re
trying to raise 7,500 donations by the end of the month so that the
campaign can continue amplifying CJ’s bold message for change.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17972?refcode=em20220430-1851&t=1021&akid=1851%2E346206%2EKe7Tm9 ]I know it would mean a lot to the team and Charles if I helped today
to raise some money for this fundraising goal. So I’m asking: Will you
chip in $5 or anything you can so my CJ can defeat Rand
Paul?

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17972?refcode=em20220430-1851&t=1022&akid=1851%2E346206%2EKe7Tm9 ]Contribute $5

Words can’t describe how proud I am of my CJ. He’s fought the good fight
his entire life and has overcome so much.

When he was growing up our family didn’t have much. We sometimes had to
stretch to make ends meet, there were times we didn’t have light or
electricity — but by God’s grace, we survived.

When you live in one of the poorest neighborhoods in Kentucky, hardship is
no stranger. All around us, we saw families struggling to put food on the
table, mamas grieving the deaths of their children lost to gun violence,
and folks losing hope in the American Dream. It’s easy to become
discouraged, witnessing that kind of suffering. But for CJ, it lit a fire
in him.

If we want a fighter in the Senate — someone who will look out for
families like yours and mine — there’s no one better than CJ. But before
he can fight for us, we need to fight for him and make sure his team has
the funds to power their massive grassroots organizing strategy.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/17972?refcode=em20220430-1851&t=1023&akid=1851%2E346206%2EKe7Tm9 ]So if you can afford to chip in $100, $20, or even just $1 — every
little bit counts. If we all pitch in whatever we can, we’ll reach this
goal in time for tonight's deadline!

Thank you,

Mama Hearn

Contribute to Charles Booker: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cb-email-donate?refcode=em20220430-1851-footer&t=1024&refcode2=1851_346206_Ke7Tm9&akid=1851%2E346206%2EKe7Tm9

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe:

You can unsubscribe from this mailing list at any time:
http://act.charlesbooker.org/cms/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?akid=1851%2E346206%2EKe7Tm9

Contributions to Booker for Kentucky are not deductible for federal income tax purposes.

body:

Friend, my campaign is about to close the books on April with a $5,271 shortfall.
Let me begin with this: I'm so grateful for your continued support. You always step up when I need you most.
But please take this to heart: Now that Republican attacks against me are ramping up, hitting these fundraising goals matters more than ever. We are operating with the most tenuous possible control of the Senate - with absolutely zero margin for error - and Democratic control will vanish if we lose a single seat.
I don't want to have to scale back our campaign efforts right now - not when I'm up against radical, Trump-loyalist opponents who want to flip this seat. We need to be bolstering our efforts to protect this Democratic seat and expand Democratic control of the Senate. With everything from women's healthcare to voting rights to climate justice and the rule of law on the line, falling short is not an option.
**Your donation right now could prevent us from facing a shortfall.**
[**So please, as someone who cares deeply about the future of our country, I 'm respectfully asking for you to make a donation of $5 or more - whatever you can spare - so we have the resources to protect this Senate seat and maintain Democratic control of the Senate. **](https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/blumenthal-email?refcode=jtk1169-fr-nd&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500)
For me, it's not just about hitting a fundraising goal. It's never just about a set of numbers on a page. It's about bolstering our campaign efforts so we can win this race and keep fighting for the values we share.
I'm grateful to have you by my side. Together, I know we can maintain Democratic control of the Senate and keep fighting for the things that matter most.
Thanks for all you do,
Dick

Together, we’ve built a coalition of moderates and progressives ready to take on the radical right.

2. **Chris has outraised his primary opponent throughout this race.** Thanks to real people all across the district who believe in our fight for the common good, we’re proud to have a financial advantage going into these final weeks before the primary.

Peter,

Today, I want to tell you a little bit about my husband Tyler that I don’t think you’ve heard yet...

Tyler and I met in high school, in Minnesota. We got married right after college, and that’s when he came to me and told me he had a calling to serve our country. We prayed about it together and decided together, that he was going to join the U.S. Marine Corps.

For nine years, as we built our life together Tyler was dialed in on one thing: serving our country. I’ve always known him like that, to have a servant’s heart. It’s the cornerstone of our marriage, and what we instill in our two young children.

When we came home and settled back down in Minnesota and Tyler joined the reserves, we became scared about the future for our family, for all families. _How were we going to afford to live, what would our kids learn in school, would crime rage in our city?_ Tyler--being the man that he is--decided he had to jump in and help somehow.

So once again, we prayed about it together, and Tyler began his race for Congress in a top swing district. He ran his race the same way he does everything, with a servant’s heart. I watched as he went from event to event, met with people and heard the changes they wanted to see in our country. Once again, I was proud to call that man my husband.

subject: Who lies less, Arrington or Mace?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dr. Annie Andrews for Congress
body:

We have to spend the next 47 days working harder than ever to grow our grassroots team and make sure South Carolinians know that I'm the candidate with the experience, courage, and track record to defeat Henry McMaster. I'm sure these goals can seem arbitrary or even gimmicky at times, but I assure you, my campaign team has spent hours combing through our budget, trying to find anything we can cut. body:

#

Good morning!
Can you start the weekend strong by [**making a donation — of even just $5 or $10 — to keep Alex Padilla in the U.S. Senate?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-apr22?refcode=em220430-1-30&t=1&refcode2=773_159979_OEK0UU&akid=773%2E159979%2EOEK0UU)
The truth is, your $5 or $10 might not seem like much compared to the billions our opponents have to throw around, but here’s the key: _it’s not just your $5 or $10._
Because just before you go to make a donation, someone else will add their $5. And by the time you’re through reading this sentence, someone else will have chipped in $10 too. And when we all stand together, it adds up pretty quickly.
[**Alex is counting on folks like you to power this campaign and keep him in the Senate fighting for immigration reform, Medicare for All, the Green New Deal, and so much more. So please, make a donation today if you can afford to do so.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ap-em-apr22?refcode=em220430-1-30&t=2&refcode2=773_159979_OEK0UU&akid=773%2E159979%2EOEK0UU)
We’re going to win this race and keep Alex in the Senate by building a truly people-powered campaign. A campaign made up of tens of thousands of people standing together. _That’s an incredibly powerful thing, and it’s ONLY possible because of your support._
So thank you once again, and have a great rest of your weekend!
\- Team Padilla

Greetings, In a minute, I am going to [ask you to make a grassroots contribution to our campaign before tonight's End of Month Fundraising Deadline.](https://clt1438602.bmetrack.com/c/l?u=DC73B6B&e=1446F24&c=15F38A&t=0&l=7D4DF0BB&email=pB9mDU3Df6foa%2BFqiXOn4nzBjzlZ2TJR&seq=2) [Before that, I need to explain why the open race for California's 15th Congressional District is so important.](https://clt1438602.bmetrack.com/c/l?u=DC73B6B&e=1446F24&c=15F38A&t=0&l=7D4DF0BB&email=pB9mDU3Df6foa%2BFqiXOn4nzBjzlZ2TJR&seq=3) Here's the situation: From the beginning, our 100% people-powered campaign made a statement with a pure progressive message, strong fundraising numbers, and NECK-AND-NECK polling results. **But then, big corporations and political insiders found their favorite candidate to oppose our progressive campaign.** Since we're REFUSING EVERY PENNY of corporate money, special interests groups felt threatened by our progressive agenda to pass Medicare for All, enact the Green New Deal, and ensure all can earn a living wage. **Here are the kind of big corporations and special interests that are bankrolling our opponent:** 1 - One Big Pharma company that was accused of selling "exorbitantly priced" medicine and then hiding the profits in tax havens. 2 - Another drug company was fined $950 Million for illegal claims when marketing its painkillers. 3 - At a time when insulin users face heightened risks from COVID-19, one of the nation's biggest corporations is facing a class-action lawsuit for hiking insulin prices on poor and underserved participants. Do you want these kinds of corporations influencing our Members of Congress? I certainly don't. That's why our campaign is swearing off 100% of Corporate PAC contributions.
[But if we don't meet our End of Month Fundraising Goal, we could risk a corporate candidate pulling ahead. Let me tell you, we still need to raise $2,119 before midnight to meet our End of Month Fundraising Goal--can you chip in today to our campaign that's 100% powered by people?](https://clt1438602.bmetrack.com/c/l?u=DC73B6B&e=1446F24&c=15F38A&t=0&l=7D4DF0BB&email=pB9mDU3Df6foa%2BFqiXOn4nzBjzlZ2TJR&seq=4) Sincerely,
David Canepa

_You know we cannot afford to let them win._

I’m honored and humbled by the support we’ve seen thus far, Peter, but if we’re going to defend this district for Democrats, we need to build a grassroots campaign capable of taking on Derrick Van Orden and his backers (like Donald Trump and Ron Johnson).

**[Over the next 101 days, we will prove that our campaign can defeat Van Orden and keep WI-03 blue, but we can only do it with your help. Before the start of this session of the Kansas Legislature, I outlined a list of three budget priorities and suggested proposals we should get done fo Friend, Before the start of this session of the Kansas Legislature, I outlined a list of three budget priorities and suggested proposals we should get done for Kansans.
Today I’m happy to pass along that we were able to work together with the Legislature to achieve all three wins - with bipartisan support on each:

✅ Phasing out our food sales tax until it is eliminated

✅ Prepaying more than $1 billion in state debt owed to KPERS, our state pension system for teachers, law enforcement, firefighters, and other public employees
✅ Setting aside $750 million for our state’s rainy day fund Like I said when we launched this campaign: keep your word, find solutions, and just get the job done. Well, we’ve gotten it done this session.
Will you help us continue to deliver results for Kansas? I know you’re on board, but could you send this to family and friends who want to see real leadership in the governor’s office? [**JOIN TEAM SCHMIDT**](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=784e1c351b584d0486218ef4941657a2&_e=Ws9WW9OjFVFRtQ5iUn7H5bslrGw6_wjCBfmgDUuugXj4dEu3xTMbsF7DGHWlplFnsL_CXMw9aobXYdN_IAsT1mzPvRSgMBDym7QvHlr79Xth5ZlPVJvHJ7G2DPtwl5TJJr-ZinIPIg2hyS28iXLZvq6PrTM-5o4gSMxO1MtY3nRrzKwxSlV-TGVg1iMJNPzMYuU8je-Xmlj1k1wNViZvSDGyFF6RY7kJ_MzlTKGmaF0TUtpzMxOMRYnGdngx3tvjJzyk5v6t7Aj5rIsISGqSsm7rNRFBvsNzDejKQepHLvI9JIDUlrMB0tm5wqFN2rE5TeO1lnaA-VCU1eFmFH41It1k7RGJELWHIMwt5nE_iNzRQsxdyCUPcdLPE4ndbR71kPwDgSFK86EE9cjP8d0AohF9snRX46bLvhj8I_ehSA8S2EXl51F3r06tVIhsQcLcA2IVL9udzzBLBltSW6-k224SEfJMHmEduth-lFr7py6xtGSe4xpevqT3NsuNoTFb) I want to thank our friends in the Legislature for coming together, reaching compromise, and answering our call to reduce or eliminate the state sales tax on groceries this session. The state grocery tax should have been put on the path to elimination in 2019, but Governor Kelly’s veto stood in the way. This is a second chance to get it right.

In January, I also called for using at least $1 billion of unexpected state revenues to prepay debt the state owes to the Kansas Public Employees Retirement System. The Legislature also answered that call - and then some - by dedicating $1.125 billion to pay down debt.
Prepaying this debt will save taxpayers hundreds of millions of dollars in debt-service costs in the years ahead while stabilizing funding for other state programs and further protecting the promises made to public retirees. Governor Kelly must abandon her past support for borrowing even more from KPERS and instead sign this fiscally responsible legislation into law.

Before the session I also recommended setting aside at least $500 million in the state's rainy day fund, and after revenue projections again rose earlier this month I urged setting aside even more. The state budget approved this week would bring the total to $750 million set aside this year for a rainy day - a strong and responsible action that will help stabilize vital state services when the next economic downturn inevitably comes.

Finally, Governor Kelly vetoed legislation to help and encourage able-bodied adults to move into the workforce by strengthening requirements to work or participate in job training in order to receive some forms of public assistance. The Legislature stood strong and overrode her veto.

Speaker Ryckman, President Masterson, and all of the legislators who supported these measures deserve a great deal of credit.
[**If you support fiscal responsibility and want to see Kansas’s economy thrive,**](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=784e1c351b584d0486218ef4941657a2&_e=Ws9WW9OjFVFRtQ5iUn7H5bslrGw6_wjCBfmgDUuugXj4dEu3xTMbsF7DGHWlplFnsL_CXMw9aobXYdN_IAsT1mzPvRSgMBDym7QvHlr79Xth5ZlPVJvHJ7G2DPtwl5TJJr-ZinIPIg2hyS28iXLZvq6PrTM-5o4gSMxO1MtY3nRrzKwxSlV-TGVg1iMJNPzMYuU8je-Xmlj1k1wNViZvSDGyFF6RY7kJ_MzlTKGmaF0TUtpzMxOMRYnGdngx3tvjJzyk5v6t7Aj5rIsISGqSsm7rNRFBvsNzDejKQepHLvLIoQGtb6tMxVaIXXgONv46ZJVuw5wY9-hNPvngdRJ1cnu38em2xrhsr98rKzLIr1H1kK_oReQcx4yrt4p8oWwG1fAGSygrGAhF4i9iP3dzxmEdd4DzJ9mX6FmHoWC42atgQEyC80jDFGSz4UCFMtwwiZyfg0SJTplvnl0bQwSoq7klNNcyeljHIRkaJwGM3Ei4J78PSHX_3JTl1344_P3y)**[click now to join Team Schmidt.](http://links.schmidtforkansas.com/u/click?_t=4eb8bd5dcca54a0b993a2eb1eb42ba73&_m=784e1c351b584d0486218ef4941657a2&_e=Ws9WW9OjFVFRtQ5iUn7H5bslrGw6_wjCBfmgDUuugXj4dEu3xTMbsF7DGHWlplFnsL_CXMw9aobXYdN_IAsT1mzPvRSgMBDym7QvHlr79Xth5ZlPVJvHJ7G2DPtwl5TJJr-ZinIPIg2hyS28iXLZvq6PrTM-5o4gSMxO1MtY3nRrzKwxSlV-TGVg1iMJNPzMYuU8je-Xmlj1k1wNViZvSDGyFF6RY7kJ_MzlTKGmaF0TUtpzMxOMRYnGdngx3tvjJzyk5v6t7Aj5rIsISGqSsm7rNRFBvsNzDejKQepHLvLpzT0kB2bmhQD7Mw6mDObS5x46V8qqfQNj0NL1pEuayeLmZB5qU55U5QQiWiSMgDjmPq2o5O4vLf-qGbDx1RJhVGb-waGE-0A8GTmCul3hVb1SPjd7MicmdKcPD6gEWL1EcYETJ1V9j0GHwN59N2r0DdcjcFFUKlO2DPdiZ1bqri6-eCJjGCgDte9eEtu6TTGS9Zm7yjEXOX8aYPT7rpGG)

** These are just some of the many victories we’ve seen on big-ticket pocketbook items this session. But I know how much more we could do if we had a governor who actually agreed with our priorities and had our families’ best interests in mind. Things like preserving fairness in women’s sports and protecting parents rights when it comes to their children’s education.
That’s why I’m running for Governor – to replace Laura Kelly so we can turn our team’s advocacy efforts into more real, actionable results for Kansans.

What do you say, friend? Will you join me in making it happen? **JOIN TEAM SCHMIDT** Thanks, Derek Schmidt | |

Peter,

Today, I want to tell you a little bit about my husband Tyler that I don’t think you’ve heard yet...

Tyler and I met in high school, in Minnesota. We got married right after college, and that’s when he came to me and told me he had a calling to serve our country. We prayed about it together and decided together, that he was going to join the U.S. Marine Corps.

For nine years, as we built our life together Tyler was dialed in on one thing: serving our country. I’ve always known him like that, to have a servant’s heart. It’s the cornerstone of our marriage, and what we instill in our two young children.

When we came home and settled back down in Minnesota and Tyler joined the reserves, we became scared about the future for our family, for all families. _How were we going to afford to live, what would our kids learn in school, would crime rage in our city?_ Tyler--being the man that he is--decided he had to jump in and help somehow.

So once again, we prayed about it together, and Tyler began his race for Congress in a top swing district. He ran his race the same way he does everything, with a servant’s heart. I watched as he went from event to event, met with people and heard the changes they wanted to see in our country. Once again, I was proud to call that man my husband.

[](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=6212a1d20f2a494db353024b6248149e&_e=BF1ldl11bNC2eodtZrAu_0XLxLBD4qKhDBmkemPPvn-GIK9peeQbemUc61W-tAQlrB_gsqS6oPBAVXYQqPB10HNpd1Lg6ylHa_TFEFUzNQ47TFpaflskPjwhx4iziNxM6mtDlwAGvSXuvcM038taw678fJ2UCvkN1hhkNqS81CMBIR426I5Yfu8niWv64jp8og4xs1x_yW1vjvCEPyH1DSX5cfG23eqTHHOFzyyzf03yVjsqmHo5tNSBkRaVYzGwHZAgAtutssQCAcu3kmuv4joSvaPbchHlANaRkBiAjQ37gBDiSA8B9NLcUS4kQeufCHc2qAnQpjtOQ-VK3EpFXfqOCHRKG1b1iBqO2CFNGhuq40GJSFzYXRMsBxoySXnpDqYtz_Mutg7uvN1naxcQ-4_CJg9gkhh3bNbD57_UcqHJJ0nKN-WIU7oV9LAqOMCv)

Ultimately, Tyler was barely beat out by a well-funded Democrat who didn’t care about our children’s futures or the crime plaguing our state. But Tyler refused to accept that, and we made the decision together that he needed to run again. Now, he’s back in this race against the same opponent, and there’s still so much work to be done. [**It would be such a difference maker in this race if you would step forward and invest in Tyler today. We got married right after college, and that’s when he came to me and told me he had a calling to serve our country. We prayed about it together and decided together, that he was going to join the U.S. Marine Corps. | Peter, Today, I want to tell you a little bit about my husband Tyler that I don’t think you’ve heard yet... Tyler and I met in high school, in Minnesota. We got married right after college, and that’s when he came to me and told me he had a calling to serve our country. We prayed about it together and decided together, that he was going to join the U.S. Marine Corps. For nine years, as we built our life together Tyler was dialed in on one thing: serving our country. I’ve always known him like that, to have a servant’s heart. It’s the cornerstone of our marriage, and what we instill in our two young children. When we came home and settled back down in Minnesota and Tyler joined the reserves, we became scared about the future for our family, for all families. How were we going to afford to live, what would our kids learn in school, would crime rage in our city? Tyler--being the man that he is--decided he had to jump in and help somehow. So once again, we prayed about it together, and Tyler began his race for Congress in a top swing district. He ran his race the same way he does everything, with a servant’s heart. I watched as he went from event to event, met with people and heard the changes they wanted to see in our country. Once again, I was proud to call that man my husband. Ultimately, Tyler was barely beat out by a well-funded Democrat who didn’t care about our children’s futures or the crime plaguing our state. But Tyler refused to accept that, and we made the decision together that he needed to run again. Now, he’s back in this race against the same opponent, and there’s still so much work to be done. Tyler and I have always approached our marriage as a team. When our daughter cries because she wants more ice cream after dinner, we stick together. When our son wants to stay at the park for longer, we stick together. It might not be much, but one thing I can guarantee you about Tyler is that he will always listen to you and stick with you if you’re on his team. To you, Tyler is candidate for Congress, focused on defending our American values. But to our family, he’s dad, husband, and the hero that is trying to save the world and protect our children’s future. I’ll leave you with one parting thought... My husband Tyler is the person I trust to help raise our children, and I know he’s the man to work to fix Washington, and advocate for our children – not himself. Just like every decision we’ve made since high school we’ve prayed about it and made them together. body:
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220430-2990-header&t=1&akid=2990%2E2526796%2Ez8XQzo)
Unlike most politicians, Alexandria doesn’t spend time on the phone calling corporate donors. Instead, her time and energy is dedicated to serving her community and working people across the country – as it should be.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220430?refcode=em20220430-2990-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&refcode2=2990_2526796_z8XQzo&akid=2990%2E2526796%2Ez8XQzo)
We need Alexandria out in the world organizing with workers and communities, not fundraising. That’s why our movement pitches in through online donations – $5 or $10 at a time through emails like these, so Alexandria can stay focused on fighting for bold legislation, organizing our communities, and standing up against powerful special interests.
But to be frank, in order to match what we raised in March, we need to raise $30,000 before midnight. **If at least one in three people reading this email chips in, we’ll make up the difference in no time** – but we know not everyone is in the place to give today and we completely understand.
[If you’re able to, can you contribute $3 before midnight? Your donation will help guarantee that Alexandria has the resources to stay focused on the work that matters.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220430?refcode=em20220430-2990-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&refcode2=2990_2526796_z8XQzo&akid=2990%2E2526796%2Ez8XQzo)
**[Contribute $3](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/aoc-email-20220430?refcode=em20220430-2990-P_FND_EOM_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&refcode2=2990_2526796_z8XQzo&akid=2990%2E2526796%2Ez8XQzo)**
From joining Starbucks workers in Astoria, Queens to celebrate them becoming the first unionized Starbucks in New York City, to urging President Biden to cancel student debt – we need Alexandria’s voice.
Our campaign is only possible because of the support and dedication from individuals like you – so thank you for all that you do today and everyday.
– Team AOC

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Thank you in advance for your $25 donation towards our $1 million drive.
body:
Derek,
I’m writing to ask you to split a contribution — $25 or whatever you can afford between my campaign and CommonGood — to help counter the $1,000,000 NRSC attack ad that is on the air now. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220430_CGVA_Kelly]
Here’s the truth:
This is the biggest attack on our campaign so far. The NRSC put $1,000,000 behind this ad in one week alone, and they won’t stop there.
But we’ve seen tough times before. And thanks to you, we’ve always come out the other side stronger.
So, we need a BIG response to show them that it’s going to take a lot more than a few attack ads to stop this team and our momentum.
And Derek, it’s critical that we have everyone with us if we’re going to hit our $1,000,000 goal and set the record straight. Even $25 can make a difference if everyone is pitching in.
We’ve had a good start so far, and while our opponents may have super PACs and outside groups spending millions of dollars in attack ads against us, we have each other. And that’s how we’ll win. Which is why I’m humbly asking:
Can you please split a donation between my campaign and CommonGood today to help us hit our $1,000,000 goal and counter the flood of outside spending pouring into this race? I would not ask were it not so important. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_mk?refcode=20220430_CGVA_Kelly]

Thank you again. Your donation today — especially today — really means a lot.
Mark Kelly

# We were CANCELED!
They tried to silence your voice
|
---

|
---
### But, they can't keep us down!
|
---
You may have noticed that the Mississippi Freedom Caucus has not been in contact with our members and supporters for about a month. The reason for that is **we were Censored and Canceled**! Our email service provider decided we were in violation of their “policies”. We have been in a battle for over a month to have our account reactivated but it was to no avail. They seemed determined to cancel our account, and we are certain it was simply because they did not like our political views. The Mississippi Freedom Caucus was not unprepared for this type of action and had backed up our list of almost 100,000 supporters in Mississippi. You read that correctly, you are a part of almost **100,000 conservatives in Mississippi** who are fighting for conservative values and freedom. You are not alone in this fight and the Mississippi Freedom Caucus is doing everything in our power to ensure your voice is heard in local, state, and national government. We have moved our list to a new service so we can continue to communicate with you and keep you informed. But we fear this is only a temporary solution. We don't know if the new provider will find a way to censore us and cancel our service. **We need a permanent solution!** The Mississippi Freedom Caucus is in discussions with another email service that is not linked to big tech liberal ideologies. This company supports the conservative principles that you and I believe in and defend. But this service, while more powerful that other email services, is significantly more expensive. We have negotiated the best price we think possible but it will still cost**$7500/year**. This new service will give us greater ability to communicate with the conservative people of Mississippi and provide you with the ability to communicate directly with your government representatives. **We need your help!** Please consider a donation to support the fight against liberals trying to cancel your voice. Conservatives must continue to spread the message of Liberty and Freedom across our state.

| | **Darin's TV AD and Sign Waving Events** Friends,

We are down to the **last 17 days** of this primary election and I am so excited about the momentum that so many of you have helped to create.

We have had so much help in this campaign. People are making phone calls, canvassing their neighborhoods, posting campaign signs, waving signs, sharing social media posts and so much more.

Now, I am happy to let you know - we are airing **our first ad on cable television** starting on Thursday. The ad tells the story of my trip to the southern border in December and my first hand experience during that trip. I saw the cartels operating with my own eyes. This was not an 11AM photo op. Please take the time to check out this ad - it's only 30 seconds long.
