Hillsdale has a new video we'd like to share with you today. It's
the trailer for our newest free online course, "C.S. Lewis on
Christianity," which we're releasing next month. I'd like you to
be one of the first people to see this video preview. You can
watch your video and pre-register for the new course below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/osZlKQRHsN

Please see a special message from our
sponsor:

Dear
Friend,

Hillsdale
has a new video we'd like to share with you today. It's the
trailer for our newest free online course, "C.S. Lewis on
Christianity," which we're releasing next month.

I'd like
you to be one of the first people to see this video preview. You
can watch your video and pre-register for the new course below:

https://lp.hillsdale.edu/cs-lewis-christianity-preregister/

C.S.
Lewis was a master at addressing life's most important questions
through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to
read.

His
signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has
inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more
believers to renew and deepen their faith-making him perhaps the
most important apologist of the twentieth century.

That's
why we are producing this new course, "C.S. Lewis on
Christianity." The goal is to share his profound insights on the
central topics of Christianity, including:

good
and evil,

conversion and faith,

prayer and the Bible,

suffering and death,

heaven and hell, and much more.

But how
do you explore the depths of Lewis's writings on these
fundamental topics in a seven-lecture course?

This is
also why we're thrilled to have Dr. Michael Ward-one of the
leading scholars of C.S. Lewis-as the instructor for the new
course.

Dr. Ward
is a distinguished teaching fellow at Hillsdale College and a
professor of theology at the University of Oxford. He is the
author of Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of
C.S. Lewis and After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis's The
Abolition of Man, and the co-editor of The Cambridge Companion to
C.S. Lewis. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford
home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

After
watching the trailer, I hope you'll want to join us and learn
from C.S. Lewis by pre-registering for this free online course.
You can easily do so on the same page as the video.

This
course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's
beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey
from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity
for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of the
Christian faith.

That's
why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of
Christianity with C.S. Lewis-enjoy your sneak peek!

Best
regards,

Kyle
Murnen, '09
Director
of Online Learning
Hillsdale
College

P.S.
There's one more thing: Will you also consider giving a special
tax-deductible gift to help promote "C.S. Lewis on Christianity"
to millions of Americans nationwide?

Your
generous gift will help us reach our $500,000 funding goal by May
16 to promote this course and our other educational efforts, like
Imprimis and our classical K-12 education programs.

As you
may know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government
funding-even indirectly in the form of federal or state student
loans and grants. That means that these courses, along with
everything else we do here, are only possible because of friends
like YOU.

The goal is to share his profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including: good and evil, conversion and faith, prayer and the Bible, suffering and death, heaven and hell, and much more. But how do you explore the depths of Lewis's writings on these fundamental topics in a seven-lecture course? This is also why we're thrilled to have Dr. Michael Ward-one of the leading scholars of C.S. Lewis-as the instructor for the new course. Dr. Ward is a distinguished teaching fellow at Hillsdale College and a professor of theology at the University of Oxford. He is the author of Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis and After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis's The Abolition of Man, and the co-editor of The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis. He even spent three years living in Lewis's Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns! After watching the trailer, I hope you'll want to join us and learn from C.S. Lewis by pre-registering for this free online course. You can easily do so on the same page as the video. This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis's beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis's own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of the Christian faith. That's why I hope you'll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis-enjoy your sneak peek! Best regards, Kyle Murnen, '09 Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College P.S. There's one more thing: Will you also consider giving a special tax-deductible gift to help promote "C.S. Lewis on Christianity" to millions of Americans nationwide? Your generous gift will help us reach our $500,000 funding goal by May 16 to promote this course and our other educational efforts, like Imprimis and our classical K-12 education programs. As you may know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding-even indirectly in the form of federal or state student loans and grants. That means that these courses, along with everything else we do here, are only possible because of friends like YOU. HB 1431 will ensure that New Hampshire parents are able to access all of the materials being taught to their children at schools. It will ensure that the schools are not hiding important information about your child from you. It will ensure that your voice is heard and that you have the final say on how your child is going to be raised!

Friend -- The fastest growing political movement in the United States is not the Republican Party or the Democratic Party -- it's those who don't feel represented by the leaders of either. More than 40% of Americans are, what I call, Politically Homeless, with our two major parties each claiming full support from less than 30% of the country. | [](https://www.country1st.com/a_political_homeless_shelter?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=digest0430_nd&n=2 "WSJ Op-Ed: A Political Homeless Shelter") [WSJ Op-Ed: A Political Homeless Shelter](https://www.country1st.com/a_political_homeless_shelter?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=digest0430_nd&n=2)
---
When our parties and leaders continue moving further from the centering principles, collaboration, compromise, and common ground that is required to achieve durable, bi-partisan solutions, the result is clear: apathy and hopelessness increase, and the problem actually gets worse.
One of our goals at Country First is to awaken the Politically Homeless to their power as we build a movement so large that the political parties must change or lose. Reasonable people of goodwill from across the ideological spectrum recognize we can't keep doing politics this way without things getting much worse. That's why our work is so important.
I penned an [Op-Ed for the Wall Street Journal](https://www.country1st.com/a_political_homeless_shelter?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=digest0430_nd&n=3) that I'd like to share, and invite you to check-out the new Politically Homeless gear in our shop \-- including a signed ball cap. All proceeds go toward fueling our movement!

Cheney release a [statement](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=dzpfx3cqdBLOGs9Sz-8L5DCywXuOJZs_3NnWx24FmU33AEP8Vv26ugKHkm-9E1n6OAWDjRoDcq9zuSFem2tc0hWvEoFvL9MTn_jbi-ePYLbM-AgAcWHwySLDyAoPwKzU9A077l1SATfzteehylG_RhjtdjliwM1TCiLyOEkpPR8&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=digest0430_nd&n=8) on Mark Meadows' newest court filing.

Here are the major developments from this past week: **2,319 Text Messages Between ark Meadows and Trump's Inner Circle Reveal Communication Before and After January 6th****** Newly [unearthed](https://www.country1st.com/r?u=9j2xrPCwd3yFLU_EZoBgHjuK3WFB2V6sENCLS_Mir3BEIfsC4rHsuXXNdVOO2svN7gUtwlbL6i6ZVMC96PjLRFdXxwz-aM9v1akrxqjKVlU&e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=digest0430_nd&n=9) text messages between the former president’s Chief of Staff, Mark Meadows, and Trump’s allies reveal the extent of communication between the election and January 6th. Nearly 2,320 messages have been released, with the names of White House staff, members of Congress, and others discussing plans to overturn the election and the events of January 6th. Many high profile members of Congress, including Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene (R-GA), Senator Ted Cruz (R-TX), and Rep. Jim Jordan (R-OH) have been named in the exclusive texts obtained by CNN. In the texts, conspiracy theories about election fraud, claims that ANTIFA was behind the insurrection, and strategies to install false electors to keep the former president in power show the echo chamber that was Mark Meadows's phone. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, earlier
this week Axios published an article about how our progressive coalition
will likely get stronger — even if status quo Democrats lose in November.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105443?refcode=em20220430-23117&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=23117%2E1203867%2EIBsl1Q ]Screenshot of a Facebook share of an Axios article. Image of Greg
Casar, Jessica Cisneros, and AOC. Headline says The Squad could grow
bigger even if Dems lose big in midterms.

The article highlighted the opportunity we have to grow our movement in
2022 and elect more Justice Democrats than ever before. By electing
progressives to open seats and challenging out-of-touch incumbents, we
have an opportunity to elect six new Justice Democrats to Congress. And
people are taking notice.

This is our chance to elect JDs alongside AOC, Jamaal, Cori, and our other
electeds to cancel student loan debt, strengthen the social safety net,
champion Medicare for All, and win a Green New Deal.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105443?refcode=em20220430-23117&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=23117%2E1203867%2EIBsl1Q ]With our next primaries coming up in a few weeks and just hours until
our end-of-month deadline, can you chip in $3 to build this
progressive movement and elect new JDs to Congress? We still need 250
grassroots contributions to meet our goal by midnight tonight.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105443?refcode=em20220430-23117&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1022&akid=23117%2E1203867%2EIBsl1Q ]Contribute

The Democratic Party establishment is out of touch with the everyday
reality of Americans. Instead of prioritizing action on the most pressing
issues, they’ve prioritized the needs of their corporate donors.

By not taking action on the filibuster or climate change, with Biden
breaking his promise to deliver investments for working families, and by
failing to provide a pathway to citizenship — Democrats will suffer in the
midterms. When Democrats lose elections, they blame progressives. But
while status quo and corporate Democrats are losing, progressives are
winning.

Are you with us,
Peter? [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105443?refcode=em20220430-23117&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1023&akid=23117%2E1203867%2EIBsl1Q ]If so, give what you
can today to make 2022 a winning year for Justice Democrats.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/105443?refcode=em20220430-23117&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1024&akid=23117%2E1203867%2EIBsl1Q ]Contribute

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1025&akid=23117%2E1203867%2EIBsl1Q ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1026&akid=23117%2E1203867%2EIBsl1Q ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

Contribute to Justice Democrats: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/justicedemocrats?refcode=em20220430-23117-footer&t=1027&refcode2=23117_1203867_IBsl1Q&akid=23117%2E1203867%2EIBsl1Q

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: Help me pick up the pace
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Beto for Texas
body:
This has been an outstanding month, and the campaign is the strongest it's
been since we first hit the trail in November. [ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55924?refcode=ema20220430-187303&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=187303%2E444211%2EPAmagq ]As this month comes to a
close, I hope you'll help us end it on a high note by making a
contribution.

We traveled the state, east to west and north to south. Big town halls in
Comal County and Missouri City where we proved that this campaign is
taking no one for granted, writing no one off. We came with the same big,
aspirational message: We’re going to bring Texans together to focus on the
big things: great jobs, world-class schools and the ability to be healthy
enough to live to our full potential.

We also brought together statewide media for press conferences on the
inflation that Abbott is causing in Texas, with big viewership across the
state. Voters throughout Texas know that he’s responsible for higher
property taxes, higher electricity bills and higher food prices at the
store.

Related to that, we went to our border ports of entry to fight for small
businesses that were being crushed by Abbott’s border business blockade —
something that this state's Agriculture Commissioner Sid Miller called
“economy killing” for Texas. Local, statewide and national outlets all
carried the message and helped us connect the dots for Texas voters who
are paying more at the grocery store because of Abbott’s costly political
stunts.

In other words — whether in person at town hall meetings across the state,
or over the airwaves and digital media — we are reaching the voters who
will decide the outcome of this election, making sure they know how badly
Abbott is hurting this state and how much we are going to help the people
of Texas.

We must be doing something right, because at the end of the month, Cecile
Richards joined our campaign as our national finance chair. To have
someone so well known for her work on behalf of labor, voting rights and
reproductive freedom join our cause — and to have her personal connection
to the last great governor of the state of Texas, Ann Richards — means the
world to me and only improves our prospects.

I feel really good about what we’re doing, where we are and where we can
go from here.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55924?refcode=ema20220430-187303&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=187303%2E444211%2EPAmagq ]I hope that you will help me close out this great month with a
significant contribution to ensure that we can not just keep up the pace,
but pick up the pace and the momentum in this critical race.

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/55924?refcode=ema20220430-187303&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=187303%2E444211%2EPAmagq ]Contribute $3

I am grateful for your help, and I am so fortunate to be running this race
with you and for the great people of Texas!

Beto

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is the most important way for us to reach you about opportunities to get involved. If you need to remove yourself from our email list, click here to unsubscribe: https://act.betoorourke.com/unsubscribe/bft-unsubscribe/?t=1022&akid=187303%2E444211%2EPAmagq

body:
Peter,

If you’ve ever wondered what my day looks like during our end-of-month push, here’s a peek:

https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-apr-2022?refcode=eom9 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/nf-email-apr-2022?refcode=eom9]

For the past week, between stops on my Lower Costs, Higher Standards tour, I’ve been on the phone with supporters like you, hearing about the struggles you’re facing under DeSantis’ authoritarian rule, and talking about my plans to bring something new to our state.

There aren’t enough hours in the day to get everyone on the phone, so I thought I’d give you the 10 second version of my pitch over email before our April deadline:

Ron DeSantis has lowered our quality of life and raised our cost of living. He’s attacked our freedoms and treated our state like his own personal authoritarian dictatorship.Floridians deserve so much better , but we’re not going to get it unless we try something new.

I’ll be on the phone pretty much non-stop for the next few hours, and you probably won’t hear from me again before our April deadline. But, before I go, I’m personally asking you — can you chip in $10 (or whatever you can — every little bit helps!) to help us bring something new to Florida? _**"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."**
--Eli Mystal, MSNBC_

Fellow American,

I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in _The Nation_.

The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line:

_"Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people."_
Well, Fellow American, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings.

_"I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers."_
**That's racist, disgusting, and sad.**

I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far.

clean_body: MSNBC invited this man to appear on their network and spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings. | "I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [Herschel Walker and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers." --Eli Mystal, MSNBC Fellow American, I recently wrote to you about a racist article attacking me in The Nation. The author had some pretty heinous things to say because I'm a Black conservative. You may recall this line: "Herschel Walker's candidacy is a white insult to Black people." Well, Fellow American, he's back at it again. MSNBC featured this man on their network this week so he could spew even more anti-Black, anti-conservative vitriol in the name of mediocre TV ratings. He doubled down in his attacks on me. This time he attacked Republican Senator Tim Scott (SC) too. Here's part of what he said: "I make a hard distinction between Black conservatives and these tokens [referring to me and Senator Tim Scott], who are out here right now, shucking and jiving for their white handlers." That's racist, disgusting, and sad. I never wanted the color of my skin to be a focal point of this Senate campaign, but these attacks on my character and my skin color have gone too far. You can help me prove them wrong by standing with me at this critical moment. We'd like to show them a groundswell of grassroots support from across Georgia and around the country. Just imagine if these comments were made by a conservative about a Black Democrat. They'd be fired immediately after going off air. I won't be quiet about this. Friend,

In a moment, I'm going to ask you to make a game-changing **[donation of $3](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/44782328/343053863/-674430938?refcode=em-4.30.22-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU3NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMDI1Zjk4OC1kZGM4LWVjMTEtOTk3ZS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=jNqueTCJ_Br9onrOk3DYcJSIX2k7h_32U5jzP1yvako=)** before our end-of-month deadline comes to a close. Our race to unseat Kevin McCarthy is at a turning point, so I hope you'll let me explain what's at stake.

As you know, Kevin McCarthy was exposed for lying about how he wanted to handle Trump's actions after Jan. 6th. We’re not shocked McCarthy lied, but realizing now that he did a complete 180 to defend Trump proves he is willing to do anything to become Speaker -- even if it means lying to the country.

Here’s the good news:

body:
Our Republican Party nominee will be selected on May 21st - will you forward this email to a few friends and make sure that they know where to vote? |
---
| | , will you do me a quick favor?

On May 21st the Republican Party will be selecting our nominee to go against Jennifer Wexton this November. However, the nominee is being selected through a party run process that looks very different from a typical primary.

I want to be sure that everyone knows how and where to vote, so I'm asking that you forward this email to 5-10 friends who live in the 10th district and make sure that they have all the voting information.
---
|
---
|
_**Election Day on May 21st, 9am-4pm**_
On May 21st, voting will be open from 9am-4pm. Your voting location is determined by where you live, and you will not be allowed to vote anywhere other than your designated voting location. You can find a full list of voting locations at www.JeanineLawson.com/Voting

For additional help determining your voting location, please call 571-484-4425 or email info@jeaninelawson.com and we can help you determine where to vote.

**Prince William County : **your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district.

If you live in **Brentsville District represented by Supervisor Jeanine Lawson** , your voting location will be Gainesville Middle School located at 8001 Limestone Drive, Gainesville.

If you live in **Gainesville District represented by Supervisor Pete Candland**, your voting location will be Bull Run Middle School located at 6308 Catharpin Road, Gainesville.

If you live in **Coles District represented by Supervisor Yesli Vega or in Occoquan District**, your voting location will be Lake Jackson Fire Station located at 11310 Coles Drive, Manassas.

**Loudoun County : **Your voting location will be determined by your magisterial district _unless you live in Blue Ridge District represented by Supervisor Tony Buffington._

If you live in **Blue Ridge district** , your district is split between two voting locations. Find your precinct by visiting the [State Board of Elections website](https://jeaninelawson.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a29f8c0771a617643b07ddf60&id=aa4357b25a&e=fc83fb200d).
Blue Ridge precincts 301, 302, 303, 305, 308, 310, 311, and 315 vote at Loudoun Valley High School.
Blue Ridge precincts 307, 309, 312, 313, 314, 316, 318, 319, 320, 321, and 322 vote at Mercer Middle School.

If you live in **Catoctin, Leesburg, or portions of Blue Ridge** districts, your voting location will be Loudoun Valley High School located at 340 N. Maple Avenue, Purcellville.

If you live in **Algonkian, Ashburn, or Broad Run** districts, your voting location is Broad Run High School located at 21670 Ashburn Road, Ashburn.

If you live in **Sterling, Dulles, or portions of Blue Ridge** districts, your voting location is Mercer Middle School located at 42149 Greenstone Drive, Aldie.

**Fauquier County :** Your county-wide voting location will be Fauquier High School located at 705 Waterloo Road, Warrenton.

**Rappahannock County** : Your county-wide voting location will be Rappahannock County Elementary School located at 34 Schoolhouse Road, Washington.

**Fairfax County** : Your voting location for all voters in the 10th district will be the Clifton Town Hall located at 12641 Chapel Road, Clifton.

**Manassas City** : Your city-wide voting location will be Grace E. Metz Middle School located at 9950 Wellington Road, Manassas.

**Manassas Park City** : Your city-wide voting location will be the Manassas Park Community Center located at 99 Adams Street, Manassas Park.

_**Early Absentee Voting**_
Early absentee voting will be available on Thursday May 12th from 4pm-8pm. The ONLY location for early voting is the Middleburg Barn, located at 23320 Foxchase Farm Lane, Middleburg.

If you have any questions, please call 571-484-4425 or email info@jeaninelawson.com and we can help you determine where to vote.

---
|
Thank you for taking the time to help your friends be informed about the upcoming election! I'm grateful for your support, and I'm counting on you to help us defeat Jennifer Wexton this November.

For love of country,

Jeanine Lawson
Candidate for Virginia's 10th Congressional District

| | Dear ,
I’m suing Katie Hobbes!

Kari Lake and I are TEAMING UP to sue Katie Hobbes and BLOCK the use of black-box vote tabulation machines in Arizona in the 2022 election.

[**This is a crucial next step for Election Integrity.**](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=fa265bef02&e=44b8c466b0)

**_There are crucial security issues endemic to the very existence of_ **black-box vote tabulation machines**. _These problems exist by design._**

In fact, the insecurity of these machines is a bipartisan issue, with concerns having been raised about the security of black-box vote tabulation machines by Democrats such as Kamala Harris and Elizabeth Warren.

(The Democrats themselves know something isn’t right!)

In addition, the lawsuit contends the following:
* It is impossible to secure electronic voting systems by design. This means the vote is by definition open to intrusion.
* Black-box vote tabulation machines use various proprietary algorithms to discern voter intent, information which is not made available to the voters or the general public.
* A computer science Expert, University of Michigan Professor J. Alex Halderman, discovered that Dominion Voting Systems machines in 16 states have “critical vulnerabilities” that will be used to “steal votes.” Further he testified: “Malware, once installed, could alter voters’ votes while subverting all procedural protections practiced by the State, including acceptance testing, hash validation, logic and accuracy testing, external firmware validation, and risk-limiting audits (RLAs).”
* Many of the parts of the machines are manufactured in China, meaning there is significant risk just in the supply chain that is used to procure these machines and is inviting Chinese intrusion into American elections.

We must go back to analog. Digital ballot counting is too rife with the potential of fraud and preventing their use is mission-critical to protecting our elections.

**I wrote you just last week as the Left was trying to take me off the ballot that I was working on going on the offensive, and this is what the offense looks like! We have to make big pushes like this against Election Fraud and the Left if we are to lock down our elections!**
---

| I am waging battle after battle here in Arizona and I need your help. We need to stay on the offensive, we need to win this lawsuit, and we need to push for more voter education to ensure that we win the primary in August for Arizona Secretary of State.

This is critical if we really want Arizona to be the GOLD STANDARD of Election Integrity.

[Can you help me on this with a donation of $25, $50, or $100 today?

I need all the help I can get to fight for Election Integrity in Arizona!](https://votefinchem.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a653829701c13e4a704cb19bf&id=04db65e6aa&e=44b8c466b0)

Thank you for your support!

body:
Hot off the press! Here is your Scheller for Congress newsletter. We have some exciting updates from the campaign as we close in on the May 17th Pri | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/38f01c0f0745/scheller-for-congress-newsletter-9016673?e=db8085a287)
---
# Lisa Scheller for Congress Newsletter!
Hi there!We are almost 2 weeks out from Primary election day and Team Scheller is hard at work all over the district! Just this week, I have been all over the 7th Congressional District talking to voters and listening to their concerns. I am proud of the campaign we are running, we are focusing on Susan Wild, out of control inflation, surging energy prices, and preserving the American Dream for future generations. That is what is at stake here. Every single person I listen to in our district shares those concerns and I will fight tooth and nail for you if you send me to Washington.When people ask me why I am running, I tell them that it is for my kids, for their future children, and for yours too. When I hear stories about small businesses like the Pub on Main in Macungie that are closing because they can’t find workers, my heart breaks for the owner, the workers, and the community that is affected. It is time to put Main Street America first again. As your voice in Washington, I’ll do just that.I am working hard but I can’t do it alone! If you are able, I would love your help over the next few weeks, whether it be stamping envelopes, texting, phone calls, door-knocking, or greeting voters at the polls! If you are interested, please use the link below!Thank you all for your support -Lisa
| [Volunteer! ](https://lisaschellerpa.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=816a990c748f610c97e80c7fc&id=090aa60336&e=db8085a287)
---

# 🚨Check out our ad!🚨

|

# Lehigh Valley Victory House
This week I visited the Victory House of the Victory House of the Lehigh Valley. This organization serves the homeless in our community and homeless veterans with the goal of transitioning them to full time housing. It was my honor to meet with the wonderful staff at this organization and lend my support to their cause.
|
---
# The Economy
I have not been shy about beating the drum against the Democrats’ spending in Washington and how that has fueled the fire of inflation that is currently at a 40 year high. Recently, reports have come out that present even more troubling news. During the first three months of 2022, our Gross Domestic Product dropped by 1.4%.This number should serve as a stark wake-up call to our leaders in Washington about the path they are leading our economy, but Democrats, most notably Susan Wild are not talking about it. The reason why is because they are at fault. Their actions led to this situation and it is about time we hold them accountable. The number one issue during this election is going to be the current state of our economy including inflation, gas prices, labor, and the supply chain. I think Congress needs more people who know what it takes to run a business and employ people in our hometowns. I know I am the candidate who can do that and I am excited to demonstrate that to the voters of the Lehigh Valley.

clean_body: Help me fight the spin | | Hi team, it’s Jahana here. Now that we are only six months away from the midterm elections, I wanted to reach out to you personally to explain why it is critical we win this race. Since being elected in 2018, we have made huge strides for our district and Connecticut as a whole. From expanding access to affordable healthcare to fighting to eliminate school hunger to bringing federal Covid relief dollars to towns and cities, restaurants and local businesses, I have worked tirelessly to improve the lives of everyday people in our community. But friend, everything we worked so hard to achieve will be GONE if Republicans take the House – and the path for them to do that runs right through the 5th District. The GOP believes that if they win this race, they can break our Democratic majority in Congress. That’s why they’ll stop at nothing. The Republican National Committee has opened a Headquarters in Connecticut for the first time ever and they’re already spending millions on attack ads to spread misinformation about me and the work I’ve done. Just a few days ago, they launched a new ad attacking me with a fear-mongering spin about the Covid relief I brought back to CT. Despite all this, friend, I know that when I have the support of real people in the community- like YOU- there is nothing we can’t do. That’s why I am urging you to make a donation to our campaign before midnight tonight. = We’ve come a long way from where we started in 2018, but there is much more work to be done. If you believe in this work, I hope you will consider making a donation to help us keep up the fight to make everyone’s lives better. | = Thank you, – Jahana | | About Jahana** Jahana Hayes proudly represents Connecticut's 5th Congressional district. #### Announcement
**>From the Desk of Haneefah Khaaliq**
More than half of all Americans support voting rights for all, police reform, gun reform, immigration reform, reproductive rights, clean energy, affordable healthcare, affordable housing, and student loan debt forgiveness.

You can have a senator who supports all of the above plus one who regularly holds town halls, has offices in all 92 counties, and one who personally comes to see about you! Sounds like a plan to me.
Now, here's what I need you to do right now:
* Forward this message to nine (9) of your friends and family. Choose three (3) of them to personally call and inform them that I meant what I said in the beginning of my campaign when I said I would run for the Senate until **_we_** won!
* Commit to my campaign now by [donating $9](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=e41efbdb4e&e=a49cb82bb3) or more to keep this true grassroots campaign going.
* [Subscribe and follow me on social media](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=52ac60e0ee&e=a49cb82bb3) where I'm active and live often. Share a post or two!

Visit [haneefahkhaaliq.org](https://haneefahkhaaliq.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b985b4d189b8b7b204cdd6958&id=9c5454bd58&e=a49cb82bb3), view my 33 national policies and agendas, and become a volunteer today! I am Indiana. You are Indiana. Together, we are Indiana!

Sincerely,
Haneefah Khaaliq, Esq.
Indiana Candidate for U.S. Senate
2022

---
| |
---
| | Jimmy Fremgen is fighting for solutions to homelessness, support for small business, to end corruption in politics, climate action, and a strong, stable, globally competitive economy that works for everyone. He’s standing up to corporate special interests and doesn’t take any money from corporate PACs or Fossil Fuel execs, so we rely on grassroots supporters like you pitching in when they can. He needs your help! Make a contribution today.
---
| | | [**DONATE NOW**](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/c3O0laI6b/c?w=kbjX_WbVQsxarWNF8bk7GOTkBb3Ma40nQ3omfZ0Rg18.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2ppbW15LWZyZW1nZW4tZm9yLWNvbmdyZXNzLTEiLCJyIjoiYzVhNGVkMDAtYzQwMi00NGM2LWE4ZWYtYTJmMzE2MDBiYzFhIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiZTllYWM2ODktYWI4Zi00NTA2LTk5ZDYtMGM0NWFjYmI5YmY4In0)

| | Friend, This week I debated my opponent, Rep. Doris Matsui in front of the Sacramento Bee’s Editorial Board as we competed for their endorsement. In a response to whether the Congresswoman had ever taken money from PG&E, her answer was: “I don’t pay attention to my fundraising...I am not the kind of person that raises millions of dollars.” Since fundraising information is [publicly available](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/c3O0laI6b/c?w=jCszoHcob35EIVqEeztIUv4Cx0wjyxDUAz2f3pZjiWk.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub3BlbnNlY3JldHMub3JnL21lbWJlcnMtb2YtY29uZ3Jlc3MvZG9yaXMtbWF0c3VpL3BhY3M_Y2lkPU4wMDAyNzQ1OSZjeWNsZT0yMDIyIiwiciI6ImMyM2VlZmZkLWMwNjItNDQwNS1lYTdiLThhNWZmMTcwZjkyOCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6ImU5ZWFjNjg5LWFiOGYtNDUwNi05OWQ2LTBjNDVhY2JiOWJmOCJ9), I pulled it up and told her that in fact she had taken more than $5,000 in 2020—the year that the company pled guilty 84 times to manslaughter related to the Camp Fire. She has raised millions for her campaign—more than $1,000,000 [per election](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/c3O0laI6b/c?w=nViIJSkjHClOoWWvPVTmMiInsLRz5PfxkG7VFk7CBKY.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cub3BlbnNlY3JldHMub3JnL21lbWJlcnMtb2YtY29uZ3Jlc3MvZG9yaXMtbWF0c3VpL3N1bW1hcnk_Y2lkPU4wMDAyNzQ1OSZjeWNsZT0yMDIyIiwiciI6ImMyM2VlZmZkLWMwNjItNDQwNS1lYTdiLThhNWZmMTcwZjkyOCIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6ImU5ZWFjNjg5LWFiOGYtNDUwNi05OWQ2LTBjNDVhY2JiOWJmOCJ9) from 2014-2020.
---
| | That’s a lot of money from corporations for someone who isn’t paying attention. I explained that I do have to pay attention to my fundraising because it all comes from regular people like you. I don’t think it should be so easy for millions of dollars from corporate PACs to flow to our elected leaders that they don’t even notice it happened. With less than 12 hours to go before the end of the month and less than ten days before ballots start hitting mailboxes in the district, will you make a donation today to help win this primary? I’ll pay attention to you even after I get elected, but I need your help to get there. If you are able to donate or [volunteer](https://shoutout.wix.com/so/c3O0laI6b/c?w=vyoU3d5Klg6FT237RcHBrCu3fa0LjK-HYJhOOP-oMPs.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZWxlY3RqaW1teS5jb20vZ2V0aW52b2x2ZWQiLCJyIjoiNjk5ODY4MjUtMzMyMi00Zjk4LTZmZGUtMmZkZDc1OTViODdiIiwibSI6Im1haWwiLCJjIjoiZTllYWM2ODktYWI4Zi00NTA2LTk5ZDYtMGM0NWFjYmI5YmY4In0), now is a hugely important time to chip in. Thank you for all your help.

disclaimer_text: Paid for by Brent Hennrich for Washington
body:
| | [ ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/atcYNHk4Eh2YdGnwBh-YDH71PPGrEzdfegloc-4ZZqW99zJc5MzSVzm_NrFMisweTmMwHq_7Xb0U1QiZD-lwuunZrR6nVggzuwjf-GROjeKZ95ZyINDIKVRk1XQsPfxY6L2jkojXmvDbK-aVgYyPcH7I8xp_K3zRvJu5GS0Flp20XnVGiTjKeAhGy_99xNWpEejf6bGynuzAZQDDO3jTT-yAjT2bqVKh5xbaUBLsbR0nDKDSRexu8kvSJZ__C5DQ/3ln/tE9j3HlTSN2N0X3JWC_9ZA/h0/9hQKnS2vQx2B5jtTW2C88zr0jK3zVU14KOth5A1SvSg)
---
Hi, Peter. The other day, I was at the pharmacy when another customer stopped, pointed at the logo on my campaign shirt, and said, "Hennrich! I'm voting for you!" We exchanged a few brief words, and each went about our day. It reminded me of the power of name recognition, especially for politics. Name ID is the top priority for our campaign. The truth is, people like you who are reading this email are very rare - only a tiny fraction of folks are paying attention to politics. But we must reach those people who are tuned out. Jaime Herrera Beutler has ignored them for so long that they don't even bother to stay informed, much less engaged enough to see there's a real choice on the ballot - someone who wants to fight for their interests. #
Hi — it’s Erica Smith. I promise this is the last email you’ll get from our campaign tonight.
We’re just hours until our make-or-break final deadline before the primary election, and my team says we’re just **2% away** from reaching our $50,000 goal.
[](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/51890?t=1&akid=1143%2E3698%2EkRY-rX)

[**_https://secure.actblue.com/donate/es-em20220331-deadline?refcode=dpwillis67@gmail.com-1_**](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/51890?t=2&akid=1143%2E3698%2EkRY-rX)
**I’ll be honest****. I need your support now more than ever.** This is one of the most competitive races in the country, and early voting for our primary has already started. We need the resources to ramp up our organizing and invest in paid communications to spread our unifying message of economic justice and counter any attacks that will come our way.
Right now, we’re being outraised by a likely Republican nominee who was literally at the January 6th insurrection and a Democratic primary challenger who voted to defund planned parenthood.
On top of all that, super PACs, corporate donors, and our opponents will all be looking to see how much money our campaign was able to raise and see if we have what it takes to win the primary and the general election in November.
**_[If it works for your budget, can you please chip in whatever you can to help us hit our final fundraising goal before the primary and get our message in front of voters?](https://act.ericaforus.com/go/51890?t=3&akid=1143%2E3698%2EkRY-rX)_** Your donation will show we have the people on our side.

Thank you for having my back,
Erica Smith
